values.note: First come, first served. Check-out 2 p.m. One wheeled camping unit (motorhome or travel trailer), up to 8 people and 2 vehicles per single site; vehicles must park on the gravel or paved spur.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/monongahela/recreation/summit-lake-campground ('Sites are not reservable. Sites are on a first come, first serve basis.', 'Maximum length of stay is 14 days.', 'Check-out time is 2:00 p.m.', 'Single site limit is one wheeled camping unit only, defined as motorhome or travel trailer; no more than 8 people; no more than 2 vehicles', last updated June 2, 2026), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 'The campground closes in winter' (no closing date). 2026 opening: May 1 ('dates are subject to change based on local weather conditions'). The lake stays accessible year-round.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/monongahela/recreation/summit-lake-campground ('Although the campground closes in winter, the lake is accessible year-round.') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/monongahela/recreation (2026 Recreation Opening Dates: 'Summit Lake Campground – 5/1'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 33 units in a semi-primitive wooded campground with paved access roads and parking spurs.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/monongahela/recreation/summit-lake-campground ('A 33-unit semi-primitive, wooded campground with paved access roads and parking spurs'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: No dump station or water fill: the Forest Service points to Four Seasons Outfitter and Adventure Sports in Richwood, Marlinton, and Cranberry Campground's donation dump station.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/monongahela/recreation/summit-lake-campground ('Potable water is not available at this site.', 'Dump station and water fill are available in Richwood at Four Seasons Outfitter and Adventure Sports. Dump stations are also available in Marlinton. Cranberry Campground has its own dump station that is donation based.'), read 2026-10-21

note: High-elevation campground.  There is a lake nearby, but the campsites are not lakefront. --Claude
summary: Forest Service page (updated June 2, 2026): confirmed $10/night and first-come only; added 14-day limit, closes in winter (2026 opening May 1, no closing date), 33 units with paved spurs, no potable water and no dump on site. No alert for FR 77. Not stated: toilets, rig length, hookups. Note trimmed of the FCFS restatement.
